response.sql: WITH source_stats AS (SELECT p.fundflux, COUNT(*) AS group_size, AVG(s.boxy / NULLIF(s.boxz, 0)) AS avg_ratio FROM scanspatial AS s JOIN projects AS p ON p.arcregistry = s.arcref GROUP BY p.fundflux), size_baseline AS (SELECT AVG(group_size) AS avg_size FROM source_stats) SELECT AVG(ss.avg_ratio) AS avg_ratio, SUM(ss.group_size) AS combined_size, AVG(ss.group_size - b.avg_size) AS avg_excess_size FROM source_stats AS ss CROSS JOIN size_baseline AS b WHERE ss.group_size > b.avg_size

assumptions.assumption: Size means the number of spatial scan records for a funding source. Ratios with a missing value or zero boxz are excluded.

alternatives.interpretation: Size counts only spatial scan records that contribute a valid ratio.
alternatives.sql: WITH source_stats AS (SELECT p.fundflux, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE s.boxy IS NOT NULL AND s.boxz IS NOT NULL AND s.boxz <> 0) AS group_size, AVG(s.boxy / NULLIF(s.boxz, 0)) AS avg_ratio FROM scanspatial AS s JOIN projects AS p ON p.arcregistry = s.arcref GROUP BY p.fundflux), size_baseline AS (SELECT AVG(group_size) AS avg_size FROM source_stats) SELECT AVG(ss.avg_ratio) AS avg_ratio, SUM(ss.group_size) AS combined_size, AVG(ss.group_size - b.avg_size) AS avg_excess_size FROM source_stats AS ss CROSS JOIN size_baseline AS b WHERE ss.group_size > b.avg_size

alternatives.interpretation: Size means the number of distinct projects represented by spatial scan records.
